risks.message: 4 SQL statements executed on every iteration of this LOOP (lines 38, 60, 62, 65): one database round-trip each per row. Prefer set-based statements.

recommendations.message: Keep joins, aggregates, CTEs and bulk DML as parameterized SQL.
Collapse per-row statements inside loops into one set-based statement.

architectural_decisions.decision: Rewrote the per-row loop (fee lookup, saldo update, TARIFA insert, audit insert per transaction) as one set-based statement with data-modifying CTEs.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Semantics allow it: the fee lookup is a lateral join, and per-account debits are pre-aggregated because UPDATE ... FROM applies at most one source row per target row.

architectural_decisions.decision: Reproduced the legacy v_taxa NUMERIC(18,2) assignment rounding with CAST(... AS NUMERIC(18,2)) at both assignment points (after GREATEST, and after the operation-type factor), instead of one combined expression.
architectural_decisions.rationale: The legacy variable rounds to 2 dp on every assignment; a single combined expression rounds only once and produced totals like 6.4495 instead of 6.46.

architectural_decisions.decision: No commit/rollback in the function; the caller owns the transaction.
architectural_decisions.rationale: The original procedure does not manage transactions itself.

warnings: The legacy v_taxa is treated as NUMERIC(18,2) (rounding on each assignment), which is the only behaviour consistent with the reference outputs; the declaration in the outline ('numeric') was assumed imprecise.

Rows with no fee in effect (CONTINUE in the original) and rows with NULL conta_origem_id are excluded via the inner lateral join and the IS NOT NULL filter; they are neither debited, nor inserted, nor counted, matching the original.
The batch summary audit row is always written, including on days with zero eligible transactions (transacoes = 0, total_taxas = 0), matching the original.
The sequential per-row saldo debit was replaced by an aggregated per-account debit; this is exact because every taxa is already rounded to 2 dp before summing.
